items.title: RED: reproduce unrelated blocking, unsafe deferral, stale reuse, and gate divergence
items.context: Before implementation, create executable failing evidence showing irrelevant Findings blocking a Story, unowned deferral disappearing, current-change regressions being deferred, stale assessments remaining accepted after scope or hash changes, and lifecycle consumers disagreeing about blocking status.

items.title: Implement authoritative applicability assessments and two safety floors
items.context: Define signed Assessment verdicts for current Story scope and freshness. Enforce both assessment-integrity and mandatory-repair floors so malformed, stale, severe, regression, safety, evidence-integrity, release, CLI-main-path, Agent parsing, or lifecycle-gate Findings cannot be deferred.

items.title: Implement defer-with-proof routing and re-evaluation lifecycle
items.context: Require canonicalDefectId, evidence, reason, target Story or B-META gap, owner, route receipt, current hash, expiry, and re-trigger conditions. Use compare-and-set updates, lineage links, and re-attestation when scope, ownership, or hashes change.

items.title: Unify gate consumption, batching, scorecards, and rollout controls
items.context: Make REVIEW, TEST, DONE, batch manifests, and reporting consume one shared blocking predicate. Add observe or warn rollout, enforcement prerequisites, scorecards, auditability, bounded failure handling, and kill or rollback controls.

items.title: GREEN: prove applicability, deferral safety, freshness, and rollout contracts
items.context: Turn every RED case GREEN and add the full verdict, severity, scope, regression, ownership, routing, hash drift, expiry, batch, concurrency, dependency, scorecard, snapshot, rollback, and kill-switch matrix required by the execution plan.
